plans.free: The blog stays online with all its content, comments and team; it just stops writing and using credits. It takes no slot. A custom domain is disconnected and the blog runs on its .topiqu.com address.

items.a: A credit is an article unit. A standard-quality article costs 1 credit, higher quality 2 or 3. Unused credits roll over to the next month, up to twice the monthly amount.

items.q: Can I add a blog I already have on Topiqu?
items.a: Yes, if you own it. If the blog has its own subscription, cancel it first so it is not paid for twice.

items.q: How do I bill my clients?
items.a: The agency shows how many credits each blog used in the period, and you can download it as CSV. You can also give each blog a monthly limit.
In the agency's billing, at any time. The subscription runs until the end of the paid period; after that the blogs move to the Free plan.
